situation: Distributing tool privileges across multiple GLM models (planner, vision, audio, edge).
decision: Only the primary planner receives write-capable tools; quantized edge models receive read-only and perception tools; keep the MCP gateway CPU-only and independently scalable.
reasoning_physics: Privilege must be least-surface: a write-capable shell should exist only where reasoning fidelity is highest and refreshable (BF16/API). A low-precision edge model given writes becomes the cheapest attack vector. Gateway decoupled from GPU keeps auth/policy infinitely scalable and cheap.
